text:
kevin: quick note — go-sdk v0.8.7 client hits parse errors when using our http->sse proxy under high packet reordering. fragments split across frames, and our sse handler assumes payload is a whole event.

 tess: logs? transport? http/2 or sse over http1?

 kevin: EventSource (http1) proxied through our edge. client uses net/http stream reader. raw lines:
 [2026-07-08T12:01:02.100Z] RECV: data: id=g-1 type=chunk payload={delta:Hel
 [2026-07-08T12:01:02.305Z] RECV: data: id=g-1 type=chunk payload=lo}
 [2026-07-08T12:01:02.310Z] PARSE_ERR: invalid character 'l' looking for beginning of value

 kevin: our go-sdk currently does json.Unmarshal on each data event immediately so the partial first fragment triggers a parse error.

 priya: is the proxy reordering or is this just TCP re-segmentation? could be either; both can split application messages.

 tess: also observed that when auth token refresh happens the client restarts EventSource and server replays last-event-id; edge retry + replay can interleave fragments from old and new sessions which makes naive reassembly harder.

 kevin: proposed fix: add a reassembly buffer keyed by stream id in the go-sdk, mirroring js-sdk behavior. use brace counting with string/escape state so we emit only when a complete JSON object is reconstructed. also detect session restart (last-event-id change) and drop or dedupe older buffered fragments.

 priya: add metrics: sdk.go.reassembly.events, sdk.go.reassembly.drops, sdk.go.reassembly.latency_ms. build a test harness that randomizes fragment order, injects delays, and simulates reconnect+replay.

 tess: short-term support mitigation: sampleapp config to set streaming.max_wait_ms=300 and streaming.max_buffer_bytes=131072; on parse error, hold partial and retry parse once more before surfacing error.

 infra-bot: Ticket INF-1601 created: "go-sdk: SSE incremental reassembly and reconnect dedupe" assigned to kevin.

 kevin: i'll pick this up tomorrow. planning a small PR + CI job, tagging @priya @tess for review. :thumbsup:
